purpose: Test a zero-call two-stage scaffold after D331: local answerability/evidence selection followed by extractive cited answer construction.

constructor_policy.name: question_pattern_evidence_span_constructor
stages: score answerability from question/evidence lexical and section cues
construct only short extractive spans or yes/no answers with inline citations
abstain when no direct evidence span is selected

decision.next_step: Run the D322 shape harness. If this beats D331/D329 without diagnostic-target use, promote the two-stage scaffold into a trainable packet.
decision.reason: This is a zero-cost scaffold test of the post-D331 hypothesis that constrained span construction is preferable to unconstrained generation.

inputs_used: optional source model predictions as non-oracle hints
